answer:
I don't know of an Ollama environment variable called `OLLAMA_UNLOAD_TIMEOUT`, so I can't give a default for it. It may not exist, or it may have been added after what I know.

Two similar variables that I do know of:

- **`OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE`** sets how long a model stays loaded in memory after its last request. The default is `5m`. This is probably what you want if you're trying to control when models unload.
- **`OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT`** sets how long to wait for a model to load before giving up. The default is `5m`.

To check whether `OLLAMA_UNLOAD_TIMEOUT` exists, run `ollama serve --help` or look at the `envconfig` package in the Ollama source. If you've seen it in some documentation, send me the link or snippet and I can help interpret it.
